core_image.text: 外から見ると、そう見える

etymology: 古ノルド語 sœma(ふさわしい) → (見た目に)ぴったり合う → 〜のように見える・〜らしい(本当かどうかは言わない)

en_definitions.text: to appear to be or to do something; to give the impression of being true.

cautions: S seem to do=It seems that S V。主語を入れかえる書きかえが最頻出
seem to have done=(今から見て)以前〜したらしい。時のずれを to have done で表す
There seems to be A=Aがあるらしい / It seems to A that=Aには〜と思える
進行形にしない(×is seeming)。seem (to be) C で C は形容詞・名詞

examples.label: seem C
examples.ja: 新しい先生はやさしそうだ。

examples.label: seem to do
examples.en: He seems to know the answer.
examples.ja: 彼は答えを知っているようだ。

examples.label: It seems that
examples.en: It seems that he knows the answer.
examples.ja: 彼は答えを知っているようだ。

examples.label: seem to have done
examples.en: She seems to have lost her way.
examples.ja: 彼女は道に迷ったらしい。

examples.label: There seems to be
examples.en: There seems to be a problem with the printer.
examples.ja: プリンターに不具合があるようだ。

examples.label: It seems to A
examples.en: It seems to me that the plan is too risky.
examples.ja: 私にはその計画は危険すぎるように思える。

check_points: He seems to know. を It seems that … に書きかえられるか
seem to have done の意味(時のずれ)を言えるか

exam.note: seem to do ⇔ It seems that の書きかえ、seem to have done が定番。
